btc.title: ₿ Bitcoin — 🟡 NEUTRAL, confidence LOW
btc.text: BTC $79,992 is +0.37% since yesterday's brief, pinned at the $80,000 line with the FOMC decision due this afternoon. ETF flows turned positive (+$110.3M on 10/26), but sentiment (F&G 48) and the dollar (DXY 102.40) edged the wrong way, markets price a likely December hike and September PPI ran hot. Villaverde's $95K year-end target is the only fresh bullish input; on-chain stays stale-carried, so confidence is capped at LOW (5/8 fresh, Woo stale). Nothing to act on before the Fed; a confirmed daily close below $79,332 is the first sign to turn defensive.
